effect.name: GM Gradient Ramp
effect.desc: A positional three-colour ramp laid over the layer - linear at any angle, radial, angular, diamond, mirrored or procedural noise. The ramp runs through three stops with a movable midpoint and a softness control that goes from a hard three-colour band through to a fully smooth blend. The noise shape scrolls and scales, which turns the ramp into a drifting colour cloud. Five blend modes and an opacity control composite it back onto the source. Everything is measured in layer space, so the ramp is welded to the layer.
